capabilities.title: Skill authoring source model
capabilities.owner_surface: Skills/** canonical source plus ask skills surfaces
capabilities.next_slice: Project-local write lifecycle can build on the existing canonical source model.
capabilities.notes: Canonical skill source exists and the ask CLI already validates authored skills.

capabilities.title: Skills SDK check facade
capabilities.next_slice: Broaden check coverage only when a later slice adds new executable SDK surfaces.
capabilities.notes: The facade routes through the canonical skill doctor and emits a receipt.

capabilities.title: Manifest schema spine
capabilities.next_slice: Extend the schema only when new manifest fields have executable owners.
capabilities.notes: Schema spine tests cover the current manifest contract.

capabilities.title: Check receipt schema
capabilities.next_slice: Add receipt families for later executable install or publish lanes.
capabilities.notes: The check facade emits schema-shaped receipt evidence.

capabilities.title: Risk classification
capabilities.next_slice: Connect risk tiers to real adapters only after those adapters are approved.
capabilities.notes: Risk classification is local and read-only.

capabilities.title: Read-only install preview
capabilities.next_slice: Real install writes require a separately approved lifecycle slice.
capabilities.notes: The SDK models target paths and lockfile delta without writing them.

capabilities.title: Read-only lockfile preview
capabilities.next_slice: Lockfile write/update is covered by PU-009 real project install receipts.
capabilities.notes: The preview reports the intended lockfile delta with would_write false.

capabilities.title: Real install writes
capabilities.next_slice: Extend cleanup to richer restore semantics only when install receipts carry before-state proof.
capabilities.notes: PU-009 performs bounded project installs only when --apply and an explicit marked --project-root are supplied; PU-010 consumes those receipts for cleanup.

capabilities.title: Trust-store mutation
capabilities.next_slice: Define trust-store ownership and rollback before any mutation.
capabilities.notes: Current SDK commands do not mutate trust state.

capabilities.title: Reference ingestion
capabilities.next_slice: Implement refs ingestion adapter with fixtures and no-network fallback.
capabilities.notes: Lifecycle output reports refs as an optional reserved surface for medium risk.

capabilities.title: Eval execution
capabilities.next_slice: Approve an eval-runner integration with local fixtures before external execution.
capabilities.notes: The SDK reports the eval lane without running eval providers.

capabilities.title: Package verification
capabilities.next_slice: Connect package verification to signed publish only after signing is approved.
capabilities.notes: Package verification is local and read-only.

capabilities.title: Package signing
capabilities.next_slice: Approve key ownership, signing adapter, and redaction policy.
capabilities.notes: The lifecycle facade reports signing as unavailable without accessing key material.

capabilities.title: Sandbox execution
capabilities.next_slice: Approve sandbox provider selection and adapter contract.
capabilities.notes: High-risk lifecycle output blocks when sandbox is required and no adapter exists.

capabilities.title: Security adapter detection
capabilities.next_slice: Add local security adapter discovery before external scanner calls.
capabilities.notes: Medium-risk status reports optional placeholder without credentials or network calls.

capabilities.title: Static local documentation artifacts
capabilities.next_slice: Hosted explorer publishing remains separate from static local docs.
capabilities.notes: Local browser artifacts exist, but no hosted docs pipeline is claimed.

capabilities.title: Skill Explorer publishing
capabilities.next_slice: Separate static local explorer from hosted publishing and add a real adapter.
capabilities.notes: The current lifecycle surface is an honest placeholder.

capabilities.title: Schema registry
capabilities.next_slice: Define registry ownership, compatibility classes, and migration policy.
capabilities.notes: Schema files exist locally, but no registry surface is implemented in PU-008.

capabilities.title: Remote registry
capabilities.next_slice: Requires a separately approved registry product slice.
capabilities.notes: PU-008 does not add remote registry behavior.

capabilities.title: Marketplace
capabilities.next_slice: Requires marketplace requirements and external service authority.
capabilities.notes: Marketplace behavior is outside V1.0 and PU-008.

capabilities.title: Publish
capabilities.next_slice: Requires registry, signing, package attestations, and owner approval.
capabilities.notes: No publish command or external mutation is added.

capabilities.title: Rollback
capabilities.next_slice: Add restore-from-before-state only when install receipts can prove exact pre-install content.
capabilities.notes: Rollback is receipt-proven and bounded to explicit marked project roots for apply; preview remains non-mutating.

capabilities.title: Uninstall
capabilities.next_slice: Add install-instance selection if the lockfile later supports duplicate active installs for one skill id.
capabilities.notes: Uninstall resolves through skills.lock.json and the source install receipt before removing digest-matched files.

capabilities.title: Compiled package pipeline
capabilities.next_slice: Design typed IR and compiler ownership before emitting packages.
capabilities.notes: The pipeline artifact describes this destination; current SDK does not compile packages.

capabilities.title: Emitters
capabilities.next_slice: Approve emitter adapter contracts and generated-output ownership.
capabilities.notes: No emitter runtime is added by PU-008.

capabilities.title: CI and adoption gates
capabilities.next_slice: Define required checks and live CI proof in a PR-specific slice.
capabilities.notes: Local validation does not prove live CI or adoption readiness.

capabilities.title: Package hardening
capabilities.next_slice: Add hardening checks after capability truth is visible and package pipeline scope is approved.
capabilities.notes: Some local package checks exist, but the broader hardening lane remains a roadmap capability.
